blocks.zh: 主題四：手套完整性測試與維護
blocks.en: Topic 4: Glove Integrity Testing and Maintenance

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 RABS 手套完整性 (Glove Integrity) 對 Grade A 環境維護的關鍵角色，以及完整性失敗的潛在影響
blocks.en: Understand the critical role of RABS glove integrity in maintaining the grade A environment, and the potential impact of integrity failure

blocks.zh: 掌握手套管理策略 (Glove Management Strategy) 的核心要素：選擇、測試、更換頻率與輪換
blocks.en: Master the core elements of a glove management strategy: selection, testing, replacement frequency and rotation

blocks.zh: 學習手套完整性失敗時的分階段調查與回應流程，建立系統性的品質風險管理 (QRM) 思維
blocks.en: Learn the tiered investigation and response process for glove integrity failure, and build a systematic quality risk management (QRM) mindset

blocks.zh: 了解預防手套損壞的操作規範、更換標準，以及維護計畫 (Preventive Maintenance) 的制定邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the operating practices that prevent glove damage, the replacement criteria, and the logic for setting up a preventive maintenance (PM) program

blocks.zh: Q4.1 How do you ensure the integrity of RABS gloves? Q4.1 如何確保 RABS 手套的完整性？
blocks.en: Q4.1 How do you ensure the integrity of RABS gloves?

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Glove Integrity (手套完整性)：指 RABS 手套作為屏障系統一部分，維持其物理密封性的能力。手套是 RABS 中最脆弱的環節之一，因為它是柔性材料，會被反覆使用、拉伸、接觸清潔劑，隨時間推移可能產生針孔 (pinhole)、撕裂或磨損。
blocks.en: Glove Integrity: the ability of a RABS glove, as part of the barrier system, to maintain its physical seal. Gloves are one of the most vulnerable points in a RABS: they are flexible material that is used repeatedly, stretched and exposed to cleaning agents, so over time they can develop pinholes, tears or wear.

blocks.zh: Pressure Test (壓力測試)：利用壓力衰減法或恆壓法，物理性地檢測手套是否有洩漏。相對於目視檢查，壓力測試能偵測微米級別的孔洞，是確保 Grade A 環境完整性的關鍵手段。
blocks.en: Pressure Test: a physical test for glove leaks using the pressure decay method or the constant pressure method. Compared with visual inspection, a pressure test can detect micron-level holes, which makes it a key means of ensuring the integrity of the grade A environment.

blocks.zh: UDAF (Unidirectional Airflow，單向氣流)：在 RABS 內從上方向下吹送的潔淨空氣，提供 First Air 保護。若手套或密封失效，外部污染物可能逆向進入。
blocks.en: UDAF (Unidirectional Airflow): clean air blown downward from above inside the RABS, providing First Air protection. If a glove or seal fails, external contaminants may enter against the airflow.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像 RABS 就像一艘潛水艇 -- 手套就是潛水艇上的「機械手臂密封圈」。潛水艇在深海中，任何一個密封點（艙門、接縫、觀察窗、機械臂介面）的洩漏都可能導致災難。你不會等到水淹進來才發現問題，而是定期做壓力測試、目視檢查，並在每次任務前確認所有密封完好。RABS 手套的管理邏輯完全一樣：預防勝於補救。
blocks.en: Think of a RABS as a submarine, and the gloves as the "sealing rings of the mechanical arms" on that submarine. Deep underwater, a leak at any sealing point (hatch, seam, viewing window, mechanical arm interface) can lead to disaster. You would not wait until water floods in to find the problem. Instead, you run regular pressure tests and visual inspections, and confirm that every seal is intact before each mission. RABS glove management follows exactly the same logic: prevention is better than cure.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 手套是 RABS 最常見的污染途徑：PtC 明確指出 "A common pathway to RABS contamination is through the use of glove ports." 這意味著所有 RABS 污染調查中，手套相關事件佔據很高比例。
blocks.en: Gloves are the most common contamination pathway in a RABS: the PtC explicitly states, "A common pathway to RABS contamination is through the use of glove ports." This means glove-related events account for a high proportion of all RABS contamination investigations.

blocks.zh: 即時監控五大參數：溫度、濕度、壓差、UDAF 風速、EM -- 這些構成了 RABS 完整性的「儀表板」。任何一項偏離都可能暗示屏障系統有問題。
blocks.en: Five real-time monitoring parameters: temperature, humidity, differential pressure, UDAF air velocity and EM. Together they form the "dashboard" of RABS integrity. A deviation in any one of them may indicate a problem with the barrier system.

blocks.zh: Campaign 期間的監控：不能只在批次結束後測試。如果在整個 campaign 結束後才發現手套失敗，可能影響多個批次，調查範圍和商業損失都會擴大。
blocks.en: Monitoring during a campaign: testing cannot be done only after a batch ends. If a glove failure is found only after the whole campaign, multiple batches may be affected, and both the scope of the investigation and the commercial loss will grow.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，同一條 RABS 充填線可能服務多個客戶產品。如果 campaign 結束後手套完整性測試失敗，可能影響整個 campaign 中所有批次 -- 這意味著多個客戶的產品都需要進行回溯性調查 (retrospective assessment)。這不僅是品質問題，更是商譽問題。因此，許多領先 CDMO 選擇在 campaign 中間也進行手套完整性測試，以「分段」風險。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, the same RABS filling line may serve products for several customers. If the glove integrity test fails after a campaign, all batches in that campaign may be affected, which means products of multiple customers need a retrospective assessment. This is not only a quality issue but also a reputation issue. For this reason, many leading CDMOs also perform glove integrity tests in the middle of a campaign in order to "segment" the risk.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果你的 RABS 在一次 campaign 中要連續生產 5 個批次，你會在哪些時間點安排手套壓力測試？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your RABS runs 5 consecutive batches in one campaign, at which points would you schedule glove pressure tests, and why?

blocks.zh: 除了手套本身，RABS 還有哪些位置可能發生完整性喪失？請列舉至少 4 個。
blocks.en: Besides the gloves themselves, where else in a RABS could integrity be lost? List at least 4 locations.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 EM 取樣「可能」偵測到污染，但不能取代手套完整性測試？兩者的角色有何不同？
blocks.en: Why can EM sampling "possibly" detect contamination but cannot replace glove integrity testing? How do the roles of the two differ?

blocks.zh: Q4.2 What are the considerations for a RABS glove-management strategy? Q4.2 RABS 手套管理策略的考量事項為何？
blocks.en: Q4.2 What are the considerations for a RABS glove-management strategy?

blocks.zh: Glove Management Strategy (手套管理策略)：這不只是「定期換手套」這麼簡單，而是一個涵蓋選材、測試方法、測試頻率、更換排程、輪換政策的完整管理體系，且必須納入 CCS (污染控制策略) 中。
blocks.en: Glove Management Strategy: this is more than "changing gloves regularly". It is a complete management system covering material selection, test methods, test frequency, replacement schedule and rotation policy, and it must be included in the CCS (contamination control strategy).

blocks.zh: Preventive Maintenance, PM (預防性維護)：關鍵原則是「不要用到壞」(gloves should not be used until failure)。PM 頻率應基於風險評估，並持續依據實際數據調整。
blocks.en: Preventive Maintenance (PM): the key principle is that gloves should not be used until failure. PM frequency should be based on risk assessment and continuously adjusted according to actual data.

blocks.zh: Glove Rotation (手套輪換)：把高使用頻率區域的手套輪換到低使用頻率區域，類似於輪胎輪換，可延長整體使用壽命並平均磨損。
blocks.en: Glove Rotation: moving gloves from high-use positions to low-use positions. Like tire rotation, this extends the overall service life and evens out wear.

blocks.zh: 手套管理策略就像汽車輪胎的管理：你不會只看輪胎有沒有爆胎（視覺檢查），你還需要定期量胎壓（壓力測試）、檢查胎紋深度（物理測試），並根據磨損程度決定更換時間（PM 頻率）。更聰明的做法是前後輪定期對調（手套輪換），讓四條輪胎的磨損更均勻。如果你的車經常走崎嶇路面（高介入頻率的操作），你就需要更頻繁地檢查和更換。
blocks.en: Glove management strategy is like managing the tires of a car. You do not just check whether a tire has blown out (visual inspection). You also measure tire pressure regularly (pressure test), check tread depth (physical test), and decide when to replace according to the degree of wear (PM frequency). A smarter practice is to swap the front and rear tires periodically (glove rotation) so that all four wear more evenly. If your car often drives on rough roads (operations with frequent interventions), you need to check and replace more often.

blocks.zh: 三層防線（選材 + 測試 + 維護）：手套管理策略的三大支柱缺一不可。選擇適當的材料是第一道防線，定期測試是偵測防線，預防性更換是最終保障。
blocks.en: Three lines of defense (selection + testing + maintenance): none of the three pillars of glove management strategy can be missing. Choosing a suitable material is the first line of defense, regular testing is the detection line, and preventive replacement is the final safeguard.

blocks.zh: 數據驅動的 PM 調整：PtC 強調 PM 頻率不是一成不變的，應該根據營運數據（如磨損率、失敗率）動態調整。這體現了持續改進 (continuous improvement) 的精神。
blocks.en: Data-driven PM adjustment: the PtC stresses that PM frequency is not fixed and should be adjusted dynamically based on operational data (such as wear rate and failure rate). This reflects the spirit of continuous improvement.

blocks.zh: 輪換政策需可追溯：手套輪換不能隨便做，必須由 QRM 定義政策並有完整記錄，確保可追溯性 (traceability)。這在法規查廠時是被查核的重點。
blocks.en: Rotation policy must be traceable: glove rotation cannot be done casually. The policy must be defined under QRM and fully recorded to ensure traceability. This is a focus area during regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
手套管理策略 =
    選材 (Material Selection)
  + 測試方法 (Integrity Test Method)
      - 目視檢查 (Visual Inspection)
      - 物理測試 (Physical/Pressure Test)
  + 測試頻率 (Test Frequency)
      - 基於風險評估 (Risk-Based)
  + PM 更換排程 (Changeout Schedule)
      - 基於供應商建議 + 實際數據
  + 輪換政策 (Rotation Policy)
      - 高→低使用區域輪換
  → 全部納入 CCS 文件
blocks.en:
Glove management strategy =
    Material Selection
  + Integrity Test Method
      - Visual Inspection
      - Physical/Pressure Test
  + Test Frequency
      - Risk-Based
  + PM Changeout Schedule
      - Based on supplier recommendations + actual data
  + Rotation Policy
      - Rotate from high-use to low-use positions
  → All included in the CCS document

blocks.zh: 如果你的 RABS 有 20 個手套口，其中 4 個位於充填區域（高介入頻率），你會如何設計輪換政策？
blocks.en: If your RABS has 20 glove ports, 4 of which are in the filling area (high intervention frequency), how would you design the rotation policy?

blocks.zh: 為什麼手套管理策略必須是 CCS 的一部分，而不能只是一份獨立的 SOP？
blocks.en: Why must the glove management strategy be part of the CCS rather than just a standalone SOP?

blocks.zh: 假設近三個月你的 RABS 手套完整性測試失敗率從 1% 上升到 5%，你會採取哪些行動？
blocks.en: Suppose the glove integrity test failure rate of your RABS rose from 1% to 5% over the past three months. What actions would you take?

blocks.zh: Q4.3 What should the maintenance program be for RABS gloves? Q4.3 RABS 手套的維護計畫應如何制定？
blocks.en: Q4.3 What should the maintenance program be for RABS gloves?

blocks.zh: Planned Maintenance Program (計畫性維護計畫)：一套預先規劃的手套檢查與更換排程。核心原則是「預防性」而非「反應性」-- 不要等到手套破了才換。
blocks.en: Planned Maintenance Program: a pre-planned schedule of glove inspection and replacement. The core principle is "preventive" rather than "reactive": do not wait until a glove tears before replacing it.

blocks.zh: VPHP Delamination (VPHP 脫層)：汽化過氧化氫 (Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide) 是 RABS 常用的生物去污方法，但長期接觸可能導致某些手套材料「脫層」-- 外層和內層分離，嚴重削弱手套強度。這是一個常被忽略但極為重要的考量。
blocks.en: VPHP Delamination: vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VPHP) is a common biodecontamination method for RABS, but prolonged exposure may cause delamination of some glove materials, in which the outer and inner layers separate and the glove is severely weakened. This is an often overlooked but extremely important consideration.

blocks.zh: 這就像飛機引擎的維護計畫：你絕不會等引擎故障才去檢修（用到壞），而是根據飛行時數、起降次數、環境條件（如鹽霧、沙塵）來制定定期檢修排程。手套也是一樣：使用次數（飛行時數）、操作類型（是否接觸尖銳物件 = 惡劣飛行條件）、VPHP 暴露（腐蝕性環境）都是決定「多久該換」的關鍵因素。
blocks.en: This is like the maintenance program for an aircraft engine: you would never wait for the engine to fail before servicing it (use until failure). Instead, you set a regular maintenance schedule based on flight hours, number of takeoffs and landings, and environmental conditions (such as salt spray and sand). The same applies to gloves: number of uses (flight hours), type of operation (contact with sharp objects = harsh flying conditions) and VPHP exposure (corrosive environment) are the key factors that decide "how often to replace".

blocks.zh: "Gloves should not be used until failure" -- 這句話是黃金法則。如果你在法規查廠中被發現手套是「用到破才換」，這幾乎可以確定會被開出 observation。預防性更換的頻率必須有風險評估支持。
blocks.en: "Gloves should not be used until failure" is the golden rule. If an inspection finds that gloves are replaced only after they tear, an observation is almost certain. The frequency of preventive replacement must be supported by a risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 七大風險評估因子：材料、使用頻率、使用方式、VPHP 接觸時間/濃度、消毒劑類型、殘留產品清潔能力、歷史失敗數據。這七項構成了更換頻率決策的完整輸入。
blocks.en: Seven risk assessment factors: material, frequency of use, manner of use, VPHP exposure time/concentration, type of disinfectant, ability to clean residual product, and historical failure data. These seven items make up the complete input for the replacement frequency decision.

blocks.zh: 供應商的角色：PtC 特別提到需要供應商的輸入 (input from the vendor)。手套供應商通常會提供材料的耐化學性數據、建議使用壽命等，這些是風險評估的重要依據。
blocks.en: Role of the supplier: the PtC specifically mentions the need for input from the vendor. Glove suppliers usually provide chemical resistance data and recommended service life for the material, which are important bases for the risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家 CDMO 的品質主管，正在建立一條新的 RABS 充填線的手套維護計畫。你的 RABS 使用 VPHP 進行生物去污，每個 campaign 約 5 個批次，每批次約 8 小時。你會怎麼做？
blocks.en: Suppose you are the head of quality at a CDMO setting up a glove maintenance program for a new RABS filling line. Your RABS uses VPHP for biodecontamination, each campaign has about 5 batches, and each batch takes about 8 hours. What would you do?

blocks.zh: 首先，聯繫手套供應商取得 VPHP 相容性數據和建議更換週期
blocks.en: First, contact the glove supplier to obtain VPHP compatibility data and the recommended replacement interval

blocks.zh: 根據操作 SOP 分析每個手套口的預期使用頻率和操作類型
blocks.en: Analyze the expected frequency of use and type of operation for each glove port based on the operating SOPs

blocks.zh: 建立初始 PM 排程（例如每 30 天或每 campaign 更換）
blocks.en: Establish an initial PM schedule (for example, replacement every 30 days or every campaign)

blocks.zh: 收集前 6 個月的完整性測試數據，根據趨勢調整 PM 頻率
blocks.en: Collect integrity test data for the first 6 months and adjust the PM frequency according to trends

blocks.zh: 為什麼 VPHP 暴露時間和濃度需要被納入手套風險評估？脫層現象如何影響手套完整性？
blocks.en: Why do VPHP exposure time and concentration need to be included in the glove risk assessment? How does delamination affect glove integrity?

blocks.zh: 如果歷史數據顯示某個特定手套口的失敗率明顯高於其他位置，你會採取哪些調查和改善措施？
blocks.en: If historical data show that the failure rate of one particular glove port is clearly higher than at other positions, what investigation and improvement measures would you take?

blocks.zh: PtC 提到可以參考 Isolator 的 PtC 來了解更多維護計畫細節。RABS 手套與 Isolator 手套的維護需求有何異同？
blocks.en: The PtC notes that the Isolator PtC can be consulted for more detail on maintenance programs. What are the similarities and differences in maintenance needs between RABS gloves and isolator gloves?

blocks.zh: Q4.4 What is the response to a glove-integrity failure? Q4.4 手套完整性失效時的應對措施為何？
blocks.en: Q4.4 What is the response to a glove-integrity failure?

blocks.zh: Glove-Integrity Failure (手套完整性失敗)：指手套在完整性測試或目視檢查中被發現有針孔、撕裂、變形或其他影響密封性的缺陷。這是 RABS 操作中最具影響力的偏差 (deviation) 之一。
blocks.en: Glove-Integrity Failure: a glove found during an integrity test or visual inspection to have a pinhole, tear, deformation or other defect that affects its seal. This is one of the most impactful deviations in RABS operation.

blocks.zh: 三階段回應 (Tiered Response)：PtC 將手套失敗的回應分為三個時間點，風險等級遞增：
blocks.en: Tiered Response: the PtC divides the response to glove failure into three time points, with increasing risk:

blocks.zh: 階段一（設置期間，清潔前）：最低風險 -- 換手套並記錄即可
blocks.en: Tier 1 (during setup, before cleaning): lowest risk. Replace the glove and document it.

blocks.zh: 階段二（清潔後，產品暴露前）：中等風險 -- 換手套 + 消毒/滅菌 + 調查
blocks.en: Tier 2 (after cleaning, before product exposure): moderate risk. Replace the glove + disinfect/sterilize + investigate.

blocks.zh: 階段三（生產中或生產後）：最高風險 -- 全面調查 + 評估產品影響
blocks.en: Tier 3 (during or after production): highest risk. Full investigation + assessment of product impact.

blocks.zh: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions，矯正與預防措施)：調查完成後必須建立的改善行動，確保同類事件不再發生。
blocks.en: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions): the improvement actions that must be established once the investigation is complete, to ensure that similar events do not recur.

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家高級無菌手術室。如果手術開始前發現手套有問題，影響最小 -- 換一雙就好。如果是手術器械已經擺好但還沒切開病人時發現，你需要換手套並重新消毒整個手術區域，同時調查為什麼會發生。但如果是手術進行中才發現手套破了，這就是最嚴重的情境 -- 你必須評估病人是否已經受到感染風險，回溯整個手術過程，並對所有接觸過的器械和區域進行全面調查。RABS 手套失敗的三階段回應邏輯完全一致。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a high-end sterile operating room. If a glove problem is found before the surgery starts, the impact is minimal: just change the pair. If it is found after the instruments are laid out but before the patient is cut, you need to change the gloves and re-disinfect the entire operating area, and investigate why it happened. But if the torn glove is found only during the surgery, this is the most serious scenario: you must assess whether the patient has been exposed to infection risk, trace back through the whole procedure, and conduct a full investigation of all instruments and areas that were touched. The tiered response logic for RABS glove failure is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 回溯性影響評估是必須的："The impact on previous batches must be always considered" -- 除非你有「每批次結束後手套完整性測試合格」的紀錄可以將影響範圍縮小到當前批次，否則所有之前的批次都在調查範圍內。
blocks.en: Retrospective impact assessment is mandatory: "The impact on previous batches must be always considered". Unless you have records of a passing glove integrity test at the end of each batch that can narrow the scope to the current batch, all previous batches are within the scope of the investigation.

blocks.zh: 調查清單極為詳盡：PtC 列出了 11 個調查要素，從人員（誰發現的、誰戴過這雙手套、其資格訓練紀錄）到設備（手套位置、PM 紀錄）到製程（批次紀錄、EM 數據）。這是因為手套失敗的根因可能來自多方面。
blocks.en: The investigation checklist is extremely detailed: the PtC lists 11 investigation elements, from personnel (who found it, who wore the glove, their qualification and training records) to equipment (glove position, PM records) to process (batch records, EM data). This is because the root cause of a glove failure can come from many directions.

blocks.zh: 排除也要有理由：如果你決定某個批次不受影響而不納入調查，你必須「clearly justified and documented」。這在法規查廠中是非常容易被挑戰的點。
blocks.en: Exclusions also need a rationale: if you decide a batch is not affected and exclude it from the investigation, you must have it "clearly justified and documented". This is a point that is very easily challenged during regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：假設你的 RABS 在一個 5 批次 campaign 的第 3 批結束後的手套完整性測試中發現一隻手套有針孔。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: suppose that in the glove integrity test after batch 3 of a 5-batch campaign, a pinhole is found in one glove.

blocks.zh: 影響範圍：如果前兩批結束時沒有做手套完整性測試，則批次 1-3 都在調查範圍內
blocks.en: Scope of impact: if no glove integrity test was done at the end of the first two batches, batches 1-3 are all within the scope of the investigation

blocks.zh: 客戶通知：如果這 3 個批次涉及不同客戶的產品，你需要通知所有受影響的客戶
blocks.en: Customer notification: if these 3 batches involve products of different customers, you need to notify all affected customers

blocks.zh: 批次放行：在調查完成之前，受影響批次應暫停放行 (hold for release)
blocks.en: Batch release: until the investigation is complete, the affected batches should be placed on hold for release

blocks.zh: 商業影響：可能導致供貨延遲、客戶信心下降、額外測試成本
blocks.en: Commercial impact: possible supply delays, loss of customer confidence and additional testing costs

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼越來越多 CDMO 選擇每批次結束後都做手套完整性測試 -- 縮小風險窗口。
blocks.en: This is why more and more CDMOs choose to perform glove integrity tests at the end of every batch, to narrow the risk window.

blocks.zh: 為什麼手套失敗的調查需要回顧「氣流可視化研究」(AVS) 的結果？AVS 如何幫助評估產品受影響的風險？
blocks.en: Why does the investigation of a glove failure need to review the results of the airflow visualization study (AVS)? How does AVS help assess the risk to the product?

blocks.zh: 假設調查發現手套針孔位於指尖位置，且該手套最近一次被用於調整充填針頭。這個資訊如何影響你的風險評估？
blocks.en: Suppose the investigation finds that the glove pinhole is at a fingertip, and that the glove was most recently used to adjust a filling needle. How does this information affect your risk assessment?

blocks.zh: 請設計一份簡化的「手套完整性失敗回應決策樹」，涵蓋三個階段的回應行動。
blocks.en: Design a simplified "decision tree for glove integrity failure response" that covers the response actions for all three tiers.

blocks.zh: Q4.5 How do you prevent RABS glove damages after installation? Q4.5 如何防止 RABS 手套於安裝後損壞？
blocks.en: Q4.5 How do you prevent RABS glove damages after installation?

blocks.zh: Glove Retraction (手套收回)：當 RABS 手套不在使用時，應該向外收回（翻轉收入手套口內側），避免手套懸掛在 RABS 內部被移動零件損壞或干擾 First Air 氣流。最佳實踐是收回時保持手指伸展，方便下次使用時快速穿戴。
blocks.en: Glove Retraction: when a RABS glove is not in use, it should be retracted outward (turned back into the inside of the glove port), so that the glove does not hang inside the RABS where it could be damaged by moving parts or disturb the First Air flow. Best practice is to keep the fingers extended during retraction so the glove can be donned quickly next time.

blocks.zh: Glove Replacement Criteria (手套更換標準)：PtC 提出五項更換觸發條件：物理屬性變化、超過供應商效期、顏色偏差、彈性喪失、微粒計數趨勢上升。這些都是手套性能劣化的客觀指標。
blocks.en: Glove Replacement Criteria: the PtC gives five replacement triggers: change in physical properties, exceeding the supplier's expiry, color deviation, loss of elasticity and rising particle count trends. These are all objective indicators of glove performance deterioration.

blocks.zh: Color Variation (顏色變化)：手套顏色偏離規格可能代表材料降解（如被化學品侵蝕或紫外線老化），是一個容易被目視檢查發現的早期預警信號。
blocks.en: Color Variation: a glove color that deviates from specification may indicate material degradation (for example chemical attack or UV aging), and is an early warning signal that is easy to catch by visual inspection.

blocks.zh: 保護 RABS 手套就像保養名牌皮手套：你不會用它去搬磚頭（避免接觸尖銳物件），不會把它塞進太小的口袋裡（避免過度拉伸），不用時你會把它平放在專用盒子裡而不是隨便丟在桌上（收回手套，妥善存放）。要更換時，你會先檢查它的狀態（目視/壓力測試），然後小心地取下放入保護袋中（無菌袋），而不是隨便塞進口袋裡壓壞它。整個過程都需要「溫柔以待」。
blocks.en: Protecting RABS gloves is like caring for a pair of fine leather gloves: you would not use them to carry bricks (avoid contact with sharp objects), you would not stuff them into a pocket that is too small (avoid over-stretching), and when not in use you would lay them flat in a dedicated box rather than toss them on the desk (retract the gloves and store them properly). When it is time to replace them, you would first check their condition (visual/pressure test), then carefully remove them and put them in a protective bag (sterile pouch), rather than stuffing them into a pocket and crushing them. The whole process calls for gentle handling.

blocks.zh: 預防勝於偵測：Q4.5 的核心思想是「源頭管控」-- 與其在手套壞了之後花大量資源調查，不如從根本上預防損壞：使用圓頭工具、避免過度拉伸、不使用時收回手套。
blocks.en: Prevention is better than detection: the core idea of Q4.5 is "control at the source". Rather than spend large resources investigating after a glove has been damaged, prevent the damage at its root: use round-tipped tools, avoid over-stretching, and retract gloves when not in use.

blocks.zh: 微粒趨勢是隱性指標："Viable and total particle counts trending higher" 是一個非常精妙的更換觸發條件。手套本身可能看起來完好，但如果其附近的微粒計數持續上升，可能暗示手套材料正在降解或產生微粒脫落。
blocks.en: Particle trends are a hidden indicator: "Viable and total particle counts trending higher" is a very subtle replacement trigger. The glove itself may look intact, but if particle counts near it keep rising, this may suggest that the glove material is degrading or shedding particles.

blocks.zh: 拆卸手套也需要 SOP：PtC 特別強調拆除手套時的注意事項（輕柔取下、放置在無菌推車或無菌袋中、不要在手套上放置尖銳物品）。這是因為可重複使用的手套在拆除後可能需要清洗和重新滅菌再使用，拆除過程中的損壞會導致不必要的浪費。
blocks.en: Glove removal also needs an SOP: the PtC specifically emphasizes precautions when removing gloves (remove gently, place on a sterile cart or in sterile pouches, do not place sharp objects on the glove). This is because reusable gloves may need to be cleaned and re-sterilized after removal, and damage during removal leads to unnecessary waste.

blocks.zh: 操作員培訓重點：在 CDMO 環境中，新進操作員的手套使用培訓應包含以下實際操作演練：
blocks.en: Operator training focus: in a CDMO environment, glove-use training for new operators should include the following hands-on exercises:

blocks.zh: 工具選擇：展示潔淨室專用圓頭剪刀與普通剪刀的差異，說明為什麼不能使用尖銳工具
blocks.en: Tool selection: show the difference between cleanroom round-tipped scissors and ordinary scissors, and explain why sharp tools cannot be used

blocks.zh: 操作範圍：實際演練每個手套口的可及範圍，讓操作員了解何時該使用「更近的那隻手套」而非過度拉伸
blocks.en: Reach range: practice the reach of each glove port so that operators understand when to use "the closer glove" rather than over-stretching

blocks.zh: 收回技巧：示範正確的手套收回方式，包括保持手指伸展的技巧
blocks.en: Retraction technique: demonstrate the correct way to retract gloves, including how to keep the fingers extended

blocks.zh: 異常識別：展示顏色變化、彈性喪失、表面粗糙化等手套劣化的實際樣本
blocks.en: Abnormality recognition: show real samples of glove deterioration such as color change, loss of elasticity and surface roughening

blocks.zh: 為什麼手套不使用時需要收回？如果手套一直懸掛在 RABS 內部，可能會造成哪些問題？
blocks.en: Why do gloves need to be retracted when not in use? What problems could arise if a glove hangs inside the RABS all the time?

blocks.zh: 假設你正在建立手套更換 SOP，五項更換標準中哪些可以通過目視檢查發現？哪些需要數據趨勢分析？
blocks.en: Suppose you are drafting a glove replacement SOP. Of the five replacement criteria, which can be found by visual inspection, and which require data trend analysis?

blocks.zh: PtC 提到手套拆除後應放在「sterile or sanitized cart or in sterile pouches」。為什麼即使是要丟棄的手套，也需要小心處理？（提示：考慮完整性測試的需求）
blocks.en: The PtC says removed gloves should be placed on a "sterile or sanitized cart or in sterile pouches". Why do even gloves that are to be discarded need careful handling? (Hint: consider the need for integrity testing)

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 完整性是 RABS 的生命線：手套是 RABS 屏障系統中最常見的污染途徑，必須通過目視檢查和物理測試（壓力測試）雙重驗證其完整性，且這些程序必須納入 CCS
blocks.en: Integrity is the lifeline of a RABS: gloves are the most common contamination pathway in the RABS barrier system. Their integrity must be verified by both visual inspection and physical testing (pressure test), and these procedures must be included in the CCS

blocks.zh: 手套管理策略三大支柱：選材（材料與供應商）、測試（方法與頻率）、維護（PM 排程與輪換政策），三者缺一不可，且需基於風險評估動態調整
blocks.en: Three pillars of glove management strategy: selection (material and supplier), testing (method and frequency) and maintenance (PM schedule and rotation policy). None can be missing, and all must be adjusted dynamically based on risk assessment

blocks.zh: 「不要用到壞」是黃金法則：PM 頻率應考慮七大因子（材料、使用頻率、使用方式、VPHP 暴露、消毒劑、清潔能力、歷史數據），並持續以營運數據驅動改進
blocks.en: "Do not use until failure" is the golden rule: PM frequency should consider seven factors (material, frequency of use, manner of use, VPHP exposure, disinfectant, cleanability and historical data) and be continuously improved with operational data

blocks.zh: 失敗回應分三個階段：設置期間（低風險，換手套即可）、清潔後但生產前（中風險，需調查）、生產中/後（高風險，全面調查 + 產品影響評估 + CAPA）
blocks.en: Failure response has three tiers: during setup (low risk, just replace the glove), after cleaning but before production (medium risk, investigation required), during/after production (high risk, full investigation + product impact assessment + CAPA)

blocks.zh: 預防優於偵測：使用圓頭工具、避免過度拉伸、不用時收回手套、更換標準包含物理屬性/效期/顏色/彈性/微粒趨勢五大指標
blocks.en: Prevention is better than detection: use round-tipped tools, avoid over-stretching, retract gloves when not in use; replacement criteria cover five indicators: physical properties, expiry, color, elasticity and particle trends

blocks.zh: 回溯影響評估不可迴避：手套完整性失敗時，除非有「批次結束後測試合格」的紀錄，否則所有之前批次都在調查範圍內 -- 這是 CDMO 必須特別注意的風險管控重點
blocks.en: Retrospective impact assessment cannot be avoided: when a glove integrity failure occurs, unless there is a record of a passing test at the end of the batch, all previous batches are within the scope of the investigation. This is a risk control point that CDMOs must pay special attention to
